issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one recoverable AWS Terraform account-foundation bootstrap.

## Primary deliverable

One recoverable AWS account-foundation backend and deployment-role bootstrap isolated from existing website and workload states.

## Verification result

Backend identity, locking, versioning, recovery, provider pins, saved-plan review, and rollback checks pass from an independent readback.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one recoverable Terraform bootstrap; backend creation and state migration are internal steps.

## Dependencies

- AWS-B: #485

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Existing website and DDNS states are inventoried first
- [ ] The new backend is encrypted versioned locked and recoverable
- [ ] Deployment identity is least privilege
- [ ] No existing state is copied or dual-owned

## Owned paths

- `infra/aws/bootstrap/**`
- `docs/operations/cloud/aws/terraform-bootstrap/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/cloud/aws-c/**`

## PVF lanes

- `backend-identity`
- `lock-and-versioning`
- `recovery-rehearsal`
- `provider-pin`
- `state-isolation`

## Stop conditions

- An existing backend owner is unknown
- State recovery fails
- A reviewed plan differs at apply

## Non-goals

- Website state migration
- Runtime deployment
- CloudFormation retirement
